name: WASP-8
description: Star of 5,600 K, 90 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: WASP-8 b crosses WASP-8 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): st_teff 5600, st_rad 1.03, st_mass 1.34

quotes.title: WASP-8
quotes.card: WASP-8 is a binary star system 294 light-years away.
quotes.introduction: The star system is much younger than the Sun at 300 million to 1.2 billion years age, and is heavily enriched in heavy elements, having nearly twice the concentration of iron compared to the Sun.

notes: WASP-8 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
